title: All 175,701 auto-labelled images were trained as a single class
symptom: cwd12 holdout mAP50-95 fell to 0.40 (-0.46 vs the supervised baseline) with four species at 0.00-0.04 and Carpetweeds at 0.88.
root_cause: autolabel.py wrote class_id=0 for every pseudo-label and _merge_datasets built class_name_to_id from the first dataset with class_names, so every pseudo-label passed through as Carpetweeds.
correction_made: include_autolabel=False by default; epochs/imgsz/patience restored to baseline parity; per-dataset canonical class mapping designed for v3.0.25.
